package com.acme.common.text;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;

import org.junit.jupiter.api.Nested;
import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
import org.junit.jupiter.params.ParameterizedTest;
import org.junit.jupiter.params.provider.CsvSource;

class StringMasksTest {

    @ParameterizedTest(name = "[{index}] {0} keep {1} -> {2}")
    @CsvSource({
            "S1234567D, 4, *****567D",
            "1234, 4, 1234",
            "12, 9, 12"
    })
    void masksAllButLast(final String value, final int visible, final String expected) {
        assertThat(StringMasks.maskAllButLast(value, visible)).isEqualTo(expected);
    }

    @Test
    void nullStaysNull() {
        assertThat(StringMasks.maskAllButLast(null, 4)).isNull();
    }

    @Nested
    class Email {

        @Test
        void keepsFirstCharacterAndDomain() {
            assertThat(StringMasks.maskEmail("ana.tan@example.com")).isEqualTo("a******@example.com");
        }

        @Test
        void singleCharacterLocalPartIsFullyMasked() {
            assertThat(StringMasks.maskEmail("a@example.com")).isEqualTo("*@example.com");
        }
    }
}
